title: Environmentally relevant concentrations of 6-PPDQ disrupt vitamin D3 adsorption and receptor function in Caenorhabditis elegans
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00358J, Paper
Jingwei Wu, Liane Li, Dayu Hu, Ran Liu, Qian Bian, Dayong Wang
6-PPDQ caused damage on adsorption of vitamin D3 and function of its receptors, which was associated with the toxicity induction of 6-PPDQ.
